name: Nyx Online
summary:
Nyx Online is a free-to-play online idle RPG made in hand-crafted pixel art. Your hero hunts on their own while you take care of gear, skills and strategy, and the world is shared: other players hunt beside you on the same maps, in real time.

Begin as a Novice in the city of Trivia and choose one of six paths: Warrior, Mage, Archer, Acolyte, Thief or Merchant. Each one branches into two advanced classes, from Knight, Paladin and Archmage to Sniper, Monk, Blacksmith and Alchemist.
